propositions: Codex sessions incorrectly treat curl --netrc 401 responses as proof that Gerrit HTTPS credentials are invalid when those credentials are already proven by git-over-HTTPS via a credential helper
AGENTS.md Codex Gerrit workflow guidance must distinguish between curl --netrc (valid only when .netrc explicitly configured) and git credential fill (required for credential-helper-backed checkouts)
Documentation must provide a shell pattern for authenticated Gerrit REST polling that obtains credentials via git credential fill, passes them directly to curl without echoing or logging the password

test_codex_agent_guidance.py must assert that Codex guidance uses git credential fill for REST calls, references the 401 false-negative explanation, enforces the no-echo password requirement, and preserves existing git push guidance
